objective.text: Distinguish merging headers from replacing the current header set.

difficulty.rationale: Replace one conflicting header value while retaining unrelated headers.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A pending request already has X-Mode: old and X-Trace: abc. It must send only new as X-Mode while retaining X-Trace. Which update fits Laravel 13.40’s header behavior?

options.rationale: withHeaders recursively merges values and can preserve old alongside new for the same key.
options.misconception: withHeaders recursively merges values and can preserve old alongside new for the same key.

options.rationale: replaceHeaders replaces the supplied header’s value while retaining other header keys.
This explicitly retains both values rather than sending only new.
options.misconception: This explicitly retains both values rather than sending only new.

options.rationale: This changes the unrelated tracing header and leaves X-Mode unchanged.
options.misconception: This changes the unrelated tracing header and leaves X-Mode unchanged.
